cli.help:
Usage: {name} [--version|-v] [--help|-h]
  config get [key] [--json] [--global]
  config migrate [--dry-run] [--global] [--json]
  doctor [--json]
remedy.DECKENT_E001: Install: brew install tmux (macOS) / sudo apt install tmux (Linux). Or use spawn_backend: "subprocess"
remedy.DECKENT_E003: Create DIRECTIVES.md with sprint goals, or run: deckent init
remedy.DECKENT_E006: Another worker holds the lock, wait or run: deckent cleanup
remedy.DECKENT_E020: Run: deckent init to create a project config, or verify the config path
remedy.DECKENT_E021: Verify the import file path exists and is accessible
remedy.DECKENT_E022: Validate the JSON syntax in the import file (use a JSON linter)
remedy.DECKENT_E023: Ensure the skill directory contains a valid manifest.json
remedy.DECKENT_E024: Use alphanumeric characters and hyphens only (max 64 chars)
remedy.DECKENT_E025: Use --force to overwrite, or choose a different name
remedy.DECKENT_E026: Check the URL, your network connection, and git credentials
remedy.DECKENT_E027: The cloned repository must contain a manifest.json at the root
remedy.DECKENT_E028: manifest.json must contain id, name, and version fields
remedy.DECKENT_E029: Verify the source path exists and is accessible
remedy.DECKENT_E030: Provide a directory path containing the skill files
remedy.DECKENT_E031: Ensure the agent directory contains agent.json
remedy.DECKENT_E032: Use alphanumeric characters and hyphens only (max 64 chars)
remedy.DECKENT_E033: Use a different name or remove the existing agent first
remedy.DECKENT_E034: Run from a skill directory that contains manifest.json
remedy.DECKENT_E037: Fix or delete the global config file at ~/.deckent/config.json
remedy.DECKENT_E038: Check file permissions and JSON syntax
remedy.DECKENT_E039: Provide a valid non-empty skill name string
error.DECKENT_E040: pipeline must have at least 1 step
remedy.DECKENT_E040: Provide at least one PipelineStep with agentId and phase
remedy.DECKENT_E041: Each pipeline step must have a non-empty string agentId
remedy.DECKENT_E042: Each pipeline step must have a non-empty string phase
remedy.DECKENT_E043: Each phase in the pipeline must be unique
remedy.DECKENT_E044: SharedMemory.write requires a non-empty string key
remedy.DECKENT_E045: SharedMemory.write requires a non-empty string writerId
remedy.DECKENT_E046: Both fromTaskId and toTaskId are required for createHandoff
remedy.DECKENT_E047: Provide at least one artifact path for the handoff
remedy.DECKENT_E048: Verify the handoff ID exists in .tasks/handoffs/
remedy.DECKENT_E049: Review task dependencies to remove cycles
remedy.DECKENT_E050: Resolve git conflicts or commit changes before creating a safety point
remedy.DECKENT_E051: Ensure you are inside a git repository with at least one commit
remedy.DECKENT_E052: Check git permissions and branch name conflicts
remedy.DECKENT_E053: Provide an integer rating between 1 and 5
remedy.DECKENT_E055: Stop the existing sprint first with: deckent kill --all
remedy.DECKENT_E056: Initialize a git repo with `git init`, or set rollback_policy to "never" in config
error.DECKENT_E057: stash pop failed — uncommitted changes trapped in stash
remedy.DECKENT_E057: Run `git stash list` to see your changes, then `git stash pop` to restore manually
remedy.DECKENT_E060: Check the task file for JSON syntax errors
remedy.DECKENT_E061: Verify the task ID and that .tasks/ directory contains the task file
remedy.DECKENT_E062: SharedContext.write requires a non-empty string key
remedy.DECKENT_E063: SharedContext.write requires a non-empty string agentId
remedy.DECKENT_E064: Complete or cancel the existing experiment before creating a new one
remedy.DECKENT_E065: Verify the experiment ID exists in .deckent/experiments/
remedy.DECKENT_E066: Only active experiments can accept new results
remedy.DECKENT_E067: Verify the template file exists in the rule-templates directory
remedy.DECKENT_E068: Verify the sprint id is correct and the outcomes file exists
remedy.DECKENT_E069: Check the outcomes JSON file for syntax errors
error.DECKENT_E070: task not found in sprint outcomes
remedy.DECKENT_E070: Verify the task id was actually executed in the sprint
remedy.DECKENT_E072: No action required — the enrichment source is optional and the sync continues with the remaining catalog sources
remedy.DECKENT_E073: Use only catalog measure IDs in the formula — see BASE_MEASURES in src/core/kpi/measure-catalog.ts
remedy.DECKENT_E074: Fix the structured intent (title/files/goCriteria/nogo required) and rebuild — the builder guarantees round-trip parseability only for complete tasks.
remedy.DECKENT_E075: This is a filesystem problem (symlink cycle, path too long, or permission denied), not a scope violation — inspect the path directly
remedy.DECKENT_E076: Remove competing criteria, unresolved placeholders, or malformed verifier input before dispatch
remedy.DECKENT_E077: Inspect the host-owned checkpoint, continuation, settlement, and budget evidence for the reported integrity mismatch
remedy.DECKENT_E078: Provide an explicit budget, live metering, landing capability, and approval evidence required by the selected execution mode
remedy.DECKENT_E079: Inspect the named container, lock, worktree, settlement, or archive evidence before retrying
error.DECKENT_E080: cannot derive the Node.js runtime floor from package.json engines.node
remedy.DECKENT_E080: Fix the engines.node range in package.json to contain a parseable major version
error.DECKENT_E081: reachability probe purpose profile is incompatible with the canonical execution budget
remedy.DECKENT_E081: Raise execution_budget.purposes.reachability-probe.maxTokens to at least maxInputTokens + maxOutputTokens
error.DECKENT_E082: metered-api reachability probe requires an owner-authored USD ceiling
error.DECKENT_E092: local model runtime configuration is invalid
remedy.DECKENT_E092: Correct local_llm and local_llm.acceleration in the resolved project config before starting the daemon
error.DECKENT_E093: local model runtime process identity is unavailable
remedy.DECKENT_E093: Inspect the local-llm PID authority and restart the daemon through the canonical lifecycle command
error.DECKENT_E094: evaluation audit receipt conflicts with an existing decision
remedy.DECKENT_E094: Reconcile the existing immutable evaluation receipt before retrying the same task attempt
error.DECKENT_E095: autonomous planner or admission invariant failed
remedy.DECKENT_E095: Inspect the planner provider output and autonomous admission authority before retrying
remedy.DECKENT_E096: Inspect the selected provider, endpoint, authentication, and timeout settings
error.DECKENT_E097: MCP command input or server lookup failed
remedy.DECKENT_E097: Correct the MCP command arguments or verify the named server is registered
remedy.DECKENT_E098: Inspect the lock root and entries for symlinks, reparse targets, or concurrent replacement
remedy.DECKENT_E099: Correct the provider capability or reachability evidence named in the error
remedy.DECKENT_E100: Correct the provider limit observation, reservation, or durable evidence named in the error
remedy.DECKENT_E101: Correct the five-field cron expression named in the error
error.HOME_NOT_RESOLVED: User home could not be resolved.
error.PATH_TRAVERSAL: Path escapes the trusted root or contains unsafe components.
error.TENANT_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED: Strict isolation requires a tenant claim.
error.CONFIG_READ_IO_HOLD: Configuration could not be read; the file was preserved.
error.CONFIG_CONCURRENT_REVISION_HOLD: Configuration changed concurrently; retry after the writer finishes.
error.CONFIG_WRITE_LOCKED: Configuration lock {path} is held by pid {pid} (age {ageSeconds}s).
error.CONFIG_SECTION_DUPLICATE: Config section is already registered or reserved: {section}.
error.CONFIG_SECTION_INVALID: Config sections require strict object schemas: {section}.
error.heading: Error: {message} [{code}]
config.workers: Requested workers {workers} exceed the host recommendation {recommended}.
config.globalCorrupt: Global config is malformed; defaults apply.
what.DECKENT_E001: Deckent could not find tmux on your system.
why.DECKENT_E001: tmux is required for spawning parallel worker agents in terminal sessions.
fix.DECKENT_E001:
Install tmux: brew install tmux (macOS) or sudo apt install tmux (Linux)
Or set spawn_backend to "subprocess" in your config: deckent config set spawn_backend subprocess
what.DECKENT_E002: Deckent could not find the Claude CLI tool.
why.DECKENT_E002: The Claude CLI is required for AI-powered task execution.
fix.DECKENT_E002:
Install the Claude CLI: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
Verify installation: claude --version
what.DECKENT_E003: Brain couldn't read your DIRECTIVES.md file.
why.DECKENT_E003: The file is missing or doesn't contain any task definitions.
fix.DECKENT_E003:
Open or create DIRECTIVES.md in your project root
Add at least one task: ## Task 1: [description]
Run `deckent plan` again
what.DECKENT_E004: Your project configuration file is invalid.
why.DECKENT_E004: The config file has missing or malformed fields.
fix.DECKENT_E004:
Run `deckent doctor` to see what's wrong
Or re-initialize: `deckent init`
what.DECKENT_E005: A worker modified files outside its assigned scope.
why.DECKENT_E005: Each worker is restricted to specific directories and files to prevent conflicts.
fix.DECKENT_E005:
Check the task scope in .tasks/task-*.json
Ensure file changes stay within scope.directories and scope.filesWrite
Run `deckent status` to see which worker caused the violation
what.DECKENT_E006: A file lock is held by another worker.
why.DECKENT_E006: Multiple workers tried to modify the same file simultaneously.
fix.DECKENT_E006:
Wait for the other worker to finish
Or run `deckent cleanup` to clear stale locks
what.DECKENT_E007: The AI usage threshold has been reached.
why.DECKENT_E007: Sprint was auto-paused to prevent unexpected costs.
fix.DECKENT_E007:
Check usage with `deckent status`
Increase the threshold in config: deckent config set usage_limit <amount>
Resume with `deckent start --resume`
what.DECKENT_E008: TypeScript build failed with compilation errors.
why.DECKENT_E008: There are type errors or syntax issues in the code.
fix.DECKENT_E008:
Run `tsc --noEmit` to see the errors
Fix the reported issues
Run the build again
what.DECKENT_E009: Deckent could not find git on your system.
why.DECKENT_E009: Git is required for version control, safety points, and scope checking.
fix.DECKENT_E009:
Install git: https://git-scm.com/downloads
Verify installation: git --version
what.DECKENT_E010: Your Node.js version is below the minimum requirement.
why.DECKENT_E010: Deckent requires Node.js {major} or higher for ESM support and modern APIs.
what.DECKENT_E020: Could not find the project configuration file.
why.DECKENT_E020: The .deckent/ directory may not exist, or the config file was deleted.
fix.DECKENT_E020:
Run `deckent init` to create a new project config
Or check that .deckent/config.json exists
what.DECKENT_E021: The config file you tried to import does not exist.
why.DECKENT_E021: The file path is incorrect or the file was moved.
fix.DECKENT_E021:
Double-check the file path
Ensure the file exists and is readable
what.DECKENT_E022: The import file contains invalid JSON.
why.DECKENT_E022: There is a syntax error in the JSON file (missing comma, bracket, etc.).
fix.DECKENT_E022:
Open the file and check for JSON syntax errors
Use a JSON validator tool to find the issue
what.DECKENT_E023: The skill directory is missing its manifest.json file.
why.DECKENT_E023: Every skill must have a manifest.json describing its metadata.
fix.DECKENT_E023:
Create a manifest.json in the skill directory
Include id, name, and version fields
what.DECKENT_E024: The skill name contains invalid characters.
why.DECKENT_E024: Skill names must be alphanumeric with hyphens, max 64 characters.
fix.DECKENT_E024:
Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens
Keep the name under 64 characters
what.DECKENT_E025: A skill with this name is already installed.
why.DECKENT_E025: Skill names must be unique to avoid conflicts.
fix.DECKENT_E025:
Use --force flag to overwrite the existing skill
Or choose a different skill name
what.DECKENT_E026: Failed to clone the git repository.
why.DECKENT_E026: The URL may be wrong, network is down, or credentials are missing.
fix.DECKENT_E026:
Verify the repository URL
Check your network connection
Ensure git credentials are configured
what.DECKENT_E027: The cloned repository does not contain a manifest.json.
why.DECKENT_E027: A valid skill repository must have manifest.json at its root.
fix.DECKENT_E027: Ensure the repository has a manifest.json at the root level
what.DECKENT_E028: The manifest.json file is missing required fields.
why.DECKENT_E028: id, name, and version are required for skill registration.
fix.DECKENT_E028: Add id, name, and version fields to manifest.json
what.DECKENT_E029: The source path does not exist.
why.DECKENT_E029: The path you provided could not be found on disk.
fix.DECKENT_E029:
Check the path for typos
Ensure the directory exists
what.DECKENT_E030: The source path points to a file, not a directory.
why.DECKENT_E030: Skills must be installed from a directory containing all skill files.
fix.DECKENT_E030: Provide a directory path instead of a file path
what.DECKENT_E031: The agent directory is missing its agent.json config.
why.DECKENT_E031: Each agent must have an agent.json file defining its configuration.
fix.DECKENT_E031: Create an agent.json in the agent directory
what.DECKENT_E032: The agent name contains invalid characters.
why.DECKENT_E032: Agent names must be alphanumeric with hyphens, max 64 characters.
fix.DECKENT_E032:
Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens
Keep the name under 64 characters
what.DECKENT_E033: An agent with this name already exists.
fix.DECKENT_E033:
Choose a different agent name
Or remove the existing agent first
what.DECKENT_E034: Could not find manifest.json for publishing.
why.DECKENT_E034: Publishing requires a manifest.json in the current directory.
fix.DECKENT_E034:
Navigate to the skill directory
Ensure manifest.json exists
why.DECKENT_E035: The file contains invalid JSON syntax.
fix.DECKENT_E035:
Open manifest.json and fix syntax errors
Use a JSON validator
what.DECKENT_E036: You are not authenticated with the marketplace.
why.DECKENT_E036: A marketplace token is required for publishing skills.
what.DECKENT_E037: The global config file is corrupted or malformed.
why.DECKENT_E037: The file contains invalid JSON or unexpected structure.
fix.DECKENT_E037:
Fix the JSON in ~/.deckent/config.json
Or delete it and reconfigure: deckent config set --global ...
what.DECKENT_E038: Could not read the config file.
why.DECKENT_E038: File permissions may be wrong or the file is corrupted.
fix.DECKENT_E038:
Check file permissions: ls -la .deckent/config.json
Ensure the file contains valid JSON
what.DECKENT_E039: An empty skill name was provided.
why.DECKENT_E039: Skill names cannot be empty strings.
what.DECKENT_E040: Pipeline was created with no steps.
why.DECKENT_E040: A pipeline needs at least one step to execute.
fix.DECKENT_E040: Add at least one PipelineStep with agentId and phase
what.DECKENT_E041: A pipeline step has a missing or empty agentId.
why.DECKENT_E041: Each step must reference a valid agent.
fix.DECKENT_E041: Provide a non-empty agentId for each pipeline step
what.DECKENT_E042: A pipeline step has a missing or empty phase name.
why.DECKENT_E042: Each step must specify which phase it runs in.
fix.DECKENT_E042: Provide a non-empty phase string for each pipeline step
what.DECKENT_E043: Two or more pipeline steps share the same phase name.
why.DECKENT_E043: Phase names must be unique to prevent execution conflicts.
fix.DECKENT_E043: Rename duplicate phases to be unique
what.DECKENT_E044: Tried to write to shared memory with an empty key.
why.DECKENT_E044: Shared memory requires a valid key to store data.
fix.DECKENT_E044: Provide a non-empty string key when calling SharedMemory.write
what.DECKENT_E045: Tried to write to shared memory without identifying the writer.
why.DECKENT_E045: SharedMemory tracks which agent wrote each entry.
fix.DECKENT_E045: Provide a non-empty writerId when calling SharedMemory.write
what.DECKENT_E046: Task handoff is missing source or destination task ID.
why.DECKENT_E046: Both task IDs are required to create a valid handoff.
what.DECKENT_E047: Task handoff was created with no artifacts.
why.DECKENT_E047: A handoff must include at least one file or artifact to transfer.
fix.DECKENT_E047: Add at least one artifact path to the handoff
what.DECKENT_E048: The referenced handoff does not exist.
why.DECKENT_E048: The handoff ID may be incorrect or the handoff was not created.
fix.DECKENT_E048:
Check the handoff ID
List handoffs in .tasks/handoffs/
what.DECKENT_E049: Tasks have circular dependencies that prevent execution.
why.DECKENT_E049: Task A depends on B, which depends on A (or longer cycle).
fix.DECKENT_E049:
Review task dependencies in DIRECTIVES.md
Remove or restructure the circular chain
what.DECKENT_E050: Could not stash your uncommitted changes.
why.DECKENT_E050: There may be unresolved merge conflicts or git state issues.
fix.DECKENT_E050:
Resolve any merge conflicts
Commit or discard pending changes
Then retry the safety point
what.DECKENT_E051: Could not read the current git commit SHA.
why.DECKENT_E051: The repository may not have any commits yet, or this is not a git repo.
fix.DECKENT_E051:
Run `git init` if not a git repo
Create an initial commit: git commit --allow-empty -m "init"
what.DECKENT_E052: Could not create the safety point branch.
why.DECKENT_E052: A branch with the same name may already exist, or git permissions are wrong.
fix.DECKENT_E052:
Check for existing branches: git branch -a
Delete conflicting branch if safe
what.DECKENT_E053: An invalid rating value was provided.
why.DECKENT_E053: Ratings must be whole numbers between 1 and 5.
what.DECKENT_E056: Deckent tried to create a safety point but the project directory is not a git repository.
why.DECKENT_E056: The rollback/safety-point feature requires git to create backup branches.
fix.DECKENT_E056:
Initialize a git repository: git init && git commit --allow-empty -m "init"
Or disable rollback: deckent config set rollback_policy never
what.DECKENT_E057: Deckent stashed your uncommitted changes to create a safety point, but could not restore them.
why.DECKENT_E057: There may be merge conflicts between the stashed changes and current state.
fix.DECKENT_E057:
Run `git stash list` to see your stashed changes
Run `git stash pop` to restore them manually
If there are conflicts, resolve them, then run the sprint again
what.DECKENT_E054: A caller tried to read the metrics path before the observability library was initialized for a project root.
why.DECKENT_E054: Observability state is lazy — it must be bound to a project root via initObservability() at sprint startup.
fix.DECKENT_E054:
Call initObservability(projectRoot) once at sprint bootstrap
Or pass an explicit projectRoot to getMetricsPath(projectRoot)
what.DECKENT_E055: A new coordinator was started for a sprint that already has a live coordinator process.
why.DECKENT_E055: Only one coordinator process can run per sprint to prevent state corruption.
fix.DECKENT_E055:
Stop the existing sprint: deckent kill --all
Or wait for the current sprint to finish
If the process is stale, delete .deckent/pids/<sprintId>.pid
what.DECKENT_E060: A task file contains invalid JSON.
why.DECKENT_E060: The task file was corrupted or manually edited incorrectly.
fix.DECKENT_E060:
Check the task file in .tasks/ for syntax errors
Use a JSON validator to find the issue
what.DECKENT_E061: The task file could not be found.
why.DECKENT_E061: The task ID may be wrong or the file was deleted.
fix.DECKENT_E061:
Check that .tasks/ directory exists
Verify the task ID is correct
what.DECKENT_E062: Tried to write to shared context with an empty key.
why.DECKENT_E062: Shared context requires a valid key to store data.
fix.DECKENT_E062: Provide a non-empty string key when calling SharedContext.write
what.DECKENT_E063: Tried to write to shared context without identifying the agent.
why.DECKENT_E063: SharedContext tracks which agent wrote each entry.
fix.DECKENT_E063: Provide a non-empty agentId when calling SharedContext.write
what.DECKENT_E064: This agent already has an active experiment running.
why.DECKENT_E064: Each agent can only run one experiment at a time.
fix.DECKENT_E064:
Complete the current experiment first
Or cancel it before starting a new one
what.DECKENT_E065: The referenced experiment does not exist.
why.DECKENT_E065: The experiment ID is incorrect or the experiment was removed.
fix.DECKENT_E065:
Check the experiment ID
List experiments in .deckent/experiments/
what.DECKENT_E066: Tried to add results to a completed or cancelled experiment.
why.DECKENT_E066: Only experiments with status "active" can accept new results.
fix.DECKENT_E066:
Check experiment status
Create a new experiment if needed
what.DECKENT_E067: rule-generator could not locate a role template file on disk.
why.DECKENT_E067: Rule generation requires template files for each role (brain, auditor, worker-default).
fix.DECKENT_E067:
Check that src/core/rule-templates/<role>.template.md exists
Reinstall Deckent if templates are missing from the package
Pass a custom templateDir to loadTemplate() if templates live elsewhere
what.DECKENT_E068: No outcomes were recorded for the requested sprint.
why.DECKENT_E068: .deckent/routing/outcomes/<sprintId>.json is missing — the sprint may have been cleaned or never ran.
fix.DECKENT_E068:
Check that .deckent/routing/outcomes/<sprintId>.json exists
Run `deckent history` to list known sprints
Re-run the sprint to regenerate the outcomes file
what.DECKENT_E069: The outcomes file for the sprint could not be parsed as JSON.
why.DECKENT_E069: The file is corrupted, truncated, or was edited manually with invalid syntax.
fix.DECKENT_E069:
Open .deckent/routing/outcomes/<sprintId>.json and fix syntax errors
Restore the file from version control if possible
what.DECKENT_E070: The requested task id was not found in the sprint outcomes file.
why.DECKENT_E070: The task may not have produced a routing outcome, or the id is misspelled.
fix.DECKENT_E070:
Run `deckent retro --sprint <id>` to list task ids
Check the outcomes file: .deckent/routing/outcomes/<sprintId>.json
what.DECKENT_E071: reclassifyTaskOutcome could not persist the updated outcomes file.
why.DECKENT_E071: The directory may be read-only, the disk full, or another process holds a lock.
fix.DECKENT_E071:
Check permissions: ls -la .deckent/routing/outcomes/
Free disk space and retry
what.DECKENT_E072: An optional model-catalog enrichment source (models.dev / OpenRouter) returned a non-OK HTTP status.
why.DECKENT_E072: The remote catalog endpoint was unreachable, rate-limited, or returned a server error at sync time.
fix.DECKENT_E072:
No action required — the failing source is skipped gracefully and the catalog is built from the remaining sources
Check the remote endpoint status (models.dev / openrouter.ai) if enrichment data is consistently missing
Retry the registry sync once the remote endpoint recovers
what.DECKENT_E073: A KPI definition references an identifier in its formula that is not a known catalog measure.
why.DECKENT_E073: KPI formulas may only use measure IDs registered in the base measure catalog; an unknown identifier cannot be evaluated.
fix.DECKENT_E073:
Check the formula for typos in measure IDs
List the valid measure IDs in src/core/kpi/measure-catalog.ts (BASE_MEASURES)
Replace the unknown identifier with a valid catalog measure ID
what.DECKENT_E075: Deckent tried to resolve the real (symlink-following) filesystem path of a tool-exec argument, and the resolution itself failed before any scope check could run.
why.DECKENT_E075: A filesystem-level error — a symlink cycle (ELOOP), a path exceeding the OS length limit (ENAMETOOLONG), or a permission failure (EACCES) — prevented walking the path at all. This is distinct from DECKENT_E005 (scope violation), which only fires once a path resolves successfully to somewhere outside the allowed scope.
fix.DECKENT_E075:
Symlink cycle: trace the chain with `readlink -f <path>` or `ls -la` along each segment and remove the loop
Path too long: shorten the path or move the target closer to the filesystem root
Permission denied: check `ls -la` on the path and its parent directories and fix ownership/permissions
what.DECKENT_E076: Deckent rejected a cross-verification prompt before provider execution.
why.DECKENT_E076: The prompt violated the finite-verification authority contract and could produce an ambiguous or fabricated verdict.
fix.DECKENT_E076:
Keep acceptance criteria only in the canonical GO/NO-GO fields
Resolve placeholders before invoking cross-verification
Retry with bounded, host-authored evidence
what.DECKENT_E077: Deckent rejected execution evidence that did not satisfy its immutable authority contract.
why.DECKENT_E077: Malformed, conflicting, stale, or lineage-mismatched evidence cannot safely authorize execution or settlement.
fix.DECKENT_E077:
Inspect the exact evidence path and execution attempt identifiers in the error message
Do not edit host-owned authority files manually
Reconcile or recover the affected attempt before retrying
what.DECKENT_E078: Deckent blocked execution before provider work.
why.DECKENT_E078: The requested backend or policy did not satisfy the fail-closed execution admission contract.
fix.DECKENT_E078:
Inspect the executor, budget, landing policy, and admission mode named in the error
Use a live-metered landing-capable backend for unattended remote work
For attended hard-stop work, provide the owner-approved policy and durable approval evidence
what.DECKENT_E079: Deckent could not prove a safe Docker lifecycle transition.
why.DECKENT_E079: Continuing could create duplicate execution, leaked locks, or conflicting host-owned evidence.
fix.DECKENT_E079:
Inspect the exact resource named in the error
Reconcile the existing attempt and host settlement evidence
Retry only after the lifecycle conflict is resolved
what.DECKENT_E080: doctor tried to derive the runtime floor from the manifest and found no parseable major version.
why.DECKENT_E080: The floor is intentionally single-sourced from engines.node (row 450); an unparseable range would silently disable the check.
fix.DECKENT_E080:
Open package.json and inspect the engines.node value
Use a range that names a major version, e.g. ">=24"
what.DECKENT_E081: The owner-authored reachability-probe profile derived a total-token ceiling below the sum of its input and output ceilings.
why.DECKENT_E081: A probe whose maxTokens cannot cover input plus output would fail closed mid-flight; the derivation refuses it up front instead.
fix.DECKENT_E081:
Open the owner config and inspect execution_budget.purposes.reachability-probe
Set maxTokens >= maxInputTokens + maxOutputTokens
what.DECKENT_E082: A metered-api reachability probe was derived without an owner-authored maxUsd ceiling.
